podcast.title: 70s Desire for Change (2002)
podcast.body: In a 2002 BBC documentary, John Bettis, who wrote "Top of the World," remarked that in the 1970s, "everyone was dying to be someone else, something else," capturing a pervasive cultural sentiment of the era. "John Bettis, who wrote top of the world, said in a documentary for BBC in 2002, that in the 70s, everyone was dying to be someone else, something else."
